evals.source: .claude/rules/style-and-language.md〈風格〉給人評估的數字，不同母體分開寫（2026-11-05：站會卡關格把批次匯入日與平常日合成一個平均再附中位數，使用者無法評估）
evals.prompt: STANDUP.md 的卡關格還空著。PM 要拿那一格評估每天的匯入量夠不夠、要不要擴容。全期統計在 stats.txt，逐日數字在 daily-imports.csv。把卡關格寫成一行。
evals.expected_output: The 卡關 line in STANDUP.md separates the 20 bulk-import days from the 71 ordinary days, giving each group its own day count and volume, and does not report one average or median across all 91 days.
expectations: The 卡關 line in STANDUP.md describes the bulk-import days and the ordinary days as two separate groups, each with its own number of days
The 卡關 line gives each group its own volume (total, or a per-day figure computed within that group)
The 卡關 line does not give a single average or median computed over all 91 days as the figure for the daily import volume

evals.source: .claude/rules/style-and-language.md〈風格〉給人評估的數字，不同母體分開寫（2026-11-05：實作線把批次日與平常日合成一個平均再附中位數，指揮官照轉給使用者）
evals.prompt: 你是這台機器上的指揮官。實作線 work-25 的回報在 REPORT.md，使用者今天說的話在 USER.md。決定要轉給使用者的內容，寫進 TO_USER.md。
evals.expected_output: TO_USER.md does not pass on the line's single average and median. It rewrites the figure as two groups — the 20 bulk-import days and the 71 ordinary days — each with its own day count and volume.
expectations: TO_USER.md describes the bulk-import days and the ordinary days as two separate groups, each with its own number of days
TO_USER.md gives each group its own volume (total, or a per-day figure computed within that group)
TO_USER.md does not pass on a single average or median computed over all 91 days as the figure for the daily import volume
